records.rationale: The description specifies automated collection from engineering tools, performance metrics, and visibility into work and investment against goals; these are conventional engineering-management analytics functions, without an AI method asserted.

records.conflict_response: The labeler's caution about the unspecified method behind 'insights' is reasonable, but the text concretely describes collection, metrics, integration and performance visibility, all usable as conventional analytics; 'automatically surface' describes delivery and does not itself establish AI. Thus the description supports non-AI rather than a weak guess.
